subject.title: fix: preserve BOOTSTRAP.md in preseeded workspaces (#91931)

question: Should a pending `BOOTSTRAP.md` with no `setupCompletedAt` universally require non-profile, non-skill user-content evidence before automatic completion, including for upgraded legacy workspaces?
rationale: The code fixes the reported managed-workspace false positive, but it deliberately changes the default stale-bootstrap repair rule for existing users rather than adding an opt-in mode.

options.title: Adopt the narrowed default
options.body: Accept the one-time bootstrap contract as authoritative, after the contributor documents it and replaces the invalid proof with a successful current-runtime run.

options.title: Preserve legacy repair by policy
options.body: Keep profile-diff completion for existing workspaces and request an explicit managed-workspace mode or a narrowly defined migration boundary instead.

options.title: Pause for owner design
options.body: Leave the canonical bug open while workspace-state owners decide the durable completion-evidence contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrowed default
recommendation.body: Accept the one-time bootstrap contract as authoritative, after the contributor documents it and replaces the invalid proof with a successful current-runtime run.

likelyOwner.reason: Recurring workspace/bootstrap safety and documentation history makes this the strongest available owner for the default-behavior decision.
